dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Yes! If the train arrives on time, then I'll have to start work on time, and then I'll have to deal with that absolute nightmare of a matter on time.

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Oh, heavens! I don't want to look at that mountain of documents, and I don't want to see those impossible people either. Spare me...
